name: ListFlow: Multi-List & Task Organizer
description: A high-performance task and list organizer with Email/Password & Google sign-in supporting all email providers (Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, Gmail, work email), real-time reactive Firestore cloud synchronization, multi-list switching, group organization, drag-and-drop, quantity steppers, dark mode, PWA install, English and Arabic RTL/LTR support, and offline persistence.
